review_notes: Readability cleanup of existing recovered code only; no new native coverage. 42 exact local-token substitutions and 27 structured definitions. Preserve the control flow of Star of Extinction, Betrothed of Fire, Coils of the Medusa and the two Exodus licids; these receive local renames only. One combined incremental build; no full audit or reccmp refresh.

Ixalan: simplify activation dispatch, Siren target scans, Admiral phase routing, Field of Ruin setup and Huatli duplicate-target merging. Retain live target-count reads, callback-sensitive context checks, Revel in Riches legacy behavior and native mana-producer dispatch quirks.

Weatherlight: preserve aura activation fallback and upkeep query order, including distinct negative attachment tests. Simplify Nature's Kiss and spell/aura tails without changing callback order. Retain Lava Storm current_turn assignment and Desperate Gambit source routing.

Exodus: preserve licid type caches and transitions by exact token substitution. Replace Spike Cannibal exact 302-int clearing with memset and indexed counter snapshots, simplify Aether Tide live target resolution and remove unused local declarations, preserve repeated spell-copy checks and selection queries, and preserve AI-specific regeneration targeting and flags.
verification_policy: Affected-file hashes and exact token checks for alpha-only edits; focused review for structured edits. Build separately after the combined batch. Inventories and reccmp deferred to a larger checkpoint.
scope: Readability cleanup of existing recovered definitions; no new native coverage or gameplay-equivalence claim.
